cases.title: Hierarchical product structure
cases.stimulus: Canonical product structure supports typed containment/decomposition across product, subsystem/component and other accepted structural levels without requiring every entity to share one generic type.
cases.expected: The stated obligation is observably satisfied without changing unrelated canonical truth.
cases.adversarial: Construct a counterexample that violates 'Hierarchical product structure' while adjacent product capabilities remain healthy; the violation must remain visible and attributable.
